name: The Soul Bar
title: The Soul Bar Benidorm
paragraphs: We use cookies and other tracking technologies to improve your browsing experience on our website, to show you personalized content and targeted ads, to analyze our website traffic, and to understand where our visitors are coming from.
Our bar in Benidorm is full of Northern Soul and Motown memorabilia spanning the generations, with walls covered in retro SKA, Northern Soul and Motown paraphernalia.

We have live entertainment most nights of the week to keep you entertained from some of the best bands and DJ's in the area. We predominantly play Northern Soul & Motown music as well as other genres to keep your feet moving all night long.
We are Scooterists too with many local meets and friends who own and run their Lambrettas and Vespas, contact us to arrange a meet or to join us at one of these ever popular events.
We are a friendly bar with many friends and returning customers, we welcome everyone to our bar to enjoy the magic of Motown and our great selection of Northern Soul classics.
